title: Daily digest: NCP merger remains elusive as party lead | India-US trade deal could be sealed soon | Yarlagadda calls on Former President Ram
headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Telangana Today / The Hindu
bullets_en: NCP merger remains elusive as party leaders navigate hurdles.
India-US trade deal could be sealed soon, says Jaishankar.
Yarlagadda calls on Former President Ram Nath Kovind in Visakhapatnam.
bullets_ur: NCP ka merger abhi tak ghair yaqini hai jab ke party rehnuma rukawatein door karne mein masroof hain
India-US tijarati muahida jald tai hone ka imkaan hai, Jaishankar
Yarlagadda ne Visakhapatnam mein sabiq Sadar Ram Nath Kovind se mulaqat ki.
